name: United States
description: The United States from the first colonies through revolution, civil war and two world wars to the Moon landing and the present.

checkpoints.name: The colonies
checkpoints.note: English settlers founded Jamestown in Virginia and Plymouth in New England. Thirteen colonies grew along the Atlantic coast, and enslaved Africans were brought to work their fields.

checkpoints.name: A new nation
checkpoints.note: The colonies declared independence in 1776 and won the war. The Constitution set up a federal republic, the Louisiana Purchase doubled its size, and settlers pushed west while slavery spread south.

checkpoints.name: Civil war and industry
checkpoints.note: The Civil War ended slavery. Railways crossed the continent, Edison lit cities, the Wright brothers flew and Ford built the Model T. The crash of 1929 brought the Great Depression.

checkpoints.name: Superpower
checkpoints.note: Pearl Harbor brought the US into the Second World War. In the Cold War it faced the Soviet Union over Cuba and in Vietnam, Martin Luther King led the civil rights movement and Apollo 11 landed on the Moon.

checkpoints.name: The new century
checkpoints.note: The web and the iPhone came out of America. The attacks of 11 September 2001 led to wars in Afghanistan and Iraq, the crash of 2008 shook the economy, and Obama became the first Black president. Trump, Biden and Trump again followed, with a pandemic and the Capitol attack between.
